title: [main] Bug 650139 The Non-Deductible VAT Amount is currently not taken into account in the VAT return Austria
summary: The Austrian VAT return report (11110) now includes non-deductible VAT amounts and full base amounts in its calculations, fixing a reporting omission for Austrian users.
key_points: Non-deductible VAT amounts are now included in VAT return calculations
Full base amount types are now considered in the report
Fixes an Austrian VAT reporting accuracy issue
Adds calculation logic for previously excluded VAT types
Includes test coverage for the new functionality
quote: The Non-Deductible Base/Amount and Full Base/Amount types are currently not taken into account in the VAT return Austria
